audited_subsystems.name: Telemetry Pipeline
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: 40 EventName values via log_local_event() → JSONL append with fsync. DuckDB read-side analytical queries.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O per event (flush+fsync). No subscription model — consumers poll JSONL.
audited_subsystems.gap: No live pub/sub. Consumers cannot subscribe to event streams; they poll static files. No backpressure. No deduplication across consumers.

audited_subsystems.name: Tracing Subsystem
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: RigTraceEvent with trace_id/span_id/parent_span_id. Span start/end/event/error. TraceStore write. Context propagation via async contextvars.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O (trace store write). No live fanout.
audited_subsystems.gap: Traces are stored but not livestreamed to consumers. Frontend cannot watch spans live. No span-to-projection bridge.

audited_subsystems.name: Desktop WebSocket Server
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: 20+ message types over WebSocket. Subscribe/push projection. Rate-limited per-message-type. Flow control (max 64 outbound queue). Priority-based coalescing.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: Network (localhost WS) + CPU + memory (coalescing buffers). Polling for projection state.
audited_subsystems.gap: Projection refresh is periodic-poll-based, not event-driven. Frontend polls backend for state rather than receiving lifecycle events. Push exists for some message types but not for backend/bridge lifecycle.

audited_subsystems.name: Bridge Protocol & Runtime State
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: BridgeMessage v1 envelope with 9 kinds. BridgeRuntimeState tracker (8 states per-connection). BridgeStateMachine (16 states). LifecycleStep probe ladder (36 steps).
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O (lifecycle JSONL) + CPU (state transitions) + WebSocket push.
audited_subsystems.gap: Bridge lifecycle events are disjoint from other subsystem events. Bridge state changes don't propagate to GitHub rate-limiting, worker scheduling, or test-pressure assessment.

audited_subsystems.name: Runtime Supervisor & Tool Execution
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: RuntimeStreamEvent (6 kinds) via AsyncIterator. RuntimeAuditEvent → JSONL. Heartbeat every 1s. SupervisorStateMachine (10 states x 12 events). Stall detection.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: CPU (asyncio loop) + File I/O (audit JSONL) + Memory (stream chunks). No queue-pressure visibility.
audited_subsystems.gap: Supervisor events are consumed only by their invoker. Queue depth, backpressure, cancellation storms, and orphaned loops are not visible to other subsystems. No adaptive throttling.

audited_subsystems.name: Coordination & Fleet
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: 15+ coordination event types (session/claim/reservation/artifact/conflict/handoff). FleetCoordinationEvent and FleetAgentMessage. File-backed store.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O (coordination store). File-based rather than pub/sub.
audited_subsystems.gap: Coordination events are written to file store only. No live notification when a lease conflicts, an artifact is published, or a handoff is requested. Agents poll.

audited_subsystems.name: GitHub Integration
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: GitHubProviderOperationReceipt (content-light). Integration telemetry events (status_checked, connection_state_changed, mutation_gated/approved/refused). Operating picture reads static artifacts.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O (artifact reads) + CPU. No live GitHub API polling rate adaptation.
audited_subsystems.gap: No adaptive polling. No rate-limit events. No permission-denied event propagation. GitHub state changes don't feed other subsystems.

audited_subsystems.name: Release Gates & Tests
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: CheckResult/Finding models. CheckSeverity (BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFO). On-demand polling via CLI. Targeted tests run manually.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: CPU (on-demand checks) + File I/O. No test-pressure signals.
audited_subsystems.gap: No test-intent events. No test-churn detection. No adaptive final-validation gating. Tests run on developer demand or full-suite, not based on evidence convergence.

audited_subsystems.name: Analytics & Ralph Scanner
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: DuckDB queries over observability JSONL. Ralph scan_projections() — observe-only, max 30s, max 20 candidates. Batch processing.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: CPU (DuckDB queries) + Memory. No incremental refresh.
audited_subsystems.gap: Ralph runs on explicit demand. No trigger when projection becomes stale, new reports appear, or evidence changes. DuckDB projections are full-scan, not incremental.

audited_subsystems.name: Receipts, Evidence & Audit Trail
audited_subsystems.existing_mechanism: ReceiptEnvelope, AuditEvent → JSONL, Report Store (14 kinds), ModelObservation, SessionLifecycle with compaction/rollup.
audited_subsystems.resource_cost: File I/O (JSONL append) + CPU (SHA256). No live evidence consumption.
audited_subsystems.gap: Audit events are written but not propagated. No consumer can trigger a reaction when a receipt is created, a redaction match occurs, or a lifecycle event fires.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Backend runs continuous projection loop even when idle. No adaptive cadence.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: bridge.idle event → reduce projection cadence. bridge.active event → restore normal cadence. projection.unchanged_for_interval → increase interval.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Frontend polls projection at fixed interval regardless of backend state.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: projection.changed event → immediate push. projection.unchanged_for_interval → degrade frontend poll frequency. backend_stale event → show stalled indicator without polling.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Status returns rate_limit_status: 'unavailable' — no adaptive polling.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: github.rate_limit.near_exhausted event → reduce polling cadence, defer noncritical calls. github.rate_limit.restored event → resume normal cadence.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Tools execute immediately if lease available. No queue-pressure backoff.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: runtime.queue_pressure.high event → serialize tool invocations, pause non-critical tools. worker.capacity.available event → resume parallelism.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Coordination file store checked only on explicit poll.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: worker.file_lease_conflict event → reassign or serialize subagent. coord.artifact.published event → notify dependents. coord.handoff.requested event → immediate notification rather than polling.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Tests run on developer demand or full-suite. No evidence-convergence gate.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: test.targeted_passed + files_changed_stable events → allow final validation once. test.pressure.high event → suppress repeated full-suite runs. release_gate.evidence_converged event → allow promotion.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Hardcoded reconnect logic in bridge state machine.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: bridge.reconnect_failed event → escalate backoff window. bridge.backend_stale event → trigger backend health check before reconnect. bridge.restored event → reset backoff state.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Observability JSONL files append without bounds. GC rules static.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: telemetry.file_size_threshold_reached event → trigger compaction. session.closed event → compact session logs. artifact_gc.ready event → prune eligible artifacts.
telemetry.event_batch_appended event → incremental DuckDB refresh. analytics.new_projection_available event → trigger analytical query.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Redaction checks at artifact generation time only.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: redaction.match_detected event → immediately quarantine artifact, block release gate promotion, notify UI. redaction.quarantine_cleared event → unblock.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Telemetry enabled/disabled toggle; degradation.json marker written.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: telemetry.opt_out_detected event → reduce adaptive diagnostics, mark degraded optimization mode, suppress detailed event emission. telemetry.consent_restored event → resume normal detail.

resource_allocation_opportunities.current_behavior: Bridge lifecycle events written to JSONL; frontend polls for state.
resource_allocation_opportunities.proposed_event_driven_behavior: bridge.health events → frontend sees live topology. bridge.degraded event → frontend shows amber indicator with reason. bridge.restored event → clear degradation.

proposed_control_loops.name: Backend stale → degrade projection cadence
proposed_control_loops.decision: Increase projection refresh interval to spare_cadence. Mark frontend bridge-status as degraded.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Desktop WebSocket server, projection builder, frontend transport state
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: CPU cycles from idle polling + frontend WS bandwidth
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Fake-green projection state in frontend; frontend hammering stale backend
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Must first attempt status_refresh. Only degrade if still stale after 3 attempts over 15s. Must emit bridge.degraded telemetry event.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit bridge.degraded with stale_since, last_known_state, attempt_count. Content-light. No raw backend state.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows amber 'Backend stale' with degraded cadence indicator

proposed_control_loops.name: GitHub rate limit near exhaustion → reduce polling + defer noncritical calls
proposed_control_loops.decision: Reduce polling cadence. Defer noncritical API calls (scheduled reads, public surface checks). Prioritize mutation-intent validation only.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: GitHub provider security intake, public surface audit, profile readme check
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Lockout from critical GitHub operations due to exhausted rate limit
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Mutation-intent validation must proceed even at degraded rate. Must emit github.rate_limit.near_exhausted telemetry event. No mutation throttling — only read throttling.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit github.rate_limit.near_exhausted with remaining count only. No raw API response headers.
proposed_control_loops.reaction_timing: immediate for noncritical reads; unaffected for mutation intents
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows amber 'GitHub rate limit degraded' with estimated reset time

proposed_control_loops.name: Tool queue pressure high → serialize non-critical invocations
proposed_control_loops.decision: Serialize non-mutation tool invocations. Pause batch tool runs. Maintain mutation throughput.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Tool runtime, supervisor invoker, worker pool
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: CPU cores + memory during tool invocation storms
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Exhaustion killing critical mutation tool; OOM from unbounded tool parallelism
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Must preserve mutation tool priority. Must emit runtime.queue_pressure.high telemetry event. Serialization must be reversible — resume parallelism when pressure drops below threshold.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit runtime.queue_pressure.high with active_count, queued_count. No raw tool output.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows 'Tool queue pressure: N active, M queued'

proposed_control_loops.name: Test targeted passed + files stable → suppress full-suite runs
proposed_control_loops.decision: Suppress repeated full-suite runs. Allow single final validation pass. Notify UI that 'final validation justified'.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Release gate runner, test execution, developer CLI
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: CPU (avoided full pytest runs on constrained machine)
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Test-churn fatigue; false sense of coverage from repeated full-suite passes
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Must only suppress if: (a) targeted tests all passed, (b) no files changed since last test run, (c) developer hasn't requested explicit full suite. Must emit test.final_validation_justified event.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit test.targeted_passed with test_names_sha256, passed_count. No raw test output.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows 'Final validation justified — not yet run' badge

proposed_control_loops.name: Redaction match detected → quarantine artifact + block release gate
proposed_control_loops.decision: Quarantine the artifact. Block release gate promotion. Notify UI with redaction details (no raw content). Prevent artifact from being committed.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Redaction layer, release gate, evidence store, operating picture
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Release candidate containing credential material; evidence artifact with raw code snippets
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Quarantine must be immediate. Must record matched_pattern and artifact path. Must NOT record raw content in telemetry. Must emit redaction.match_detected with artifact_sha256 and pattern_name only.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit redaction.match_detected with artifact_sha256, pattern_name, sensitivity_class. No raw content. No matched substring.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows red 'Redaction quarantine triggered' with artifact reference

proposed_control_loops.name: Projection unchanged for interval → reduce refresh cadence
proposed_control_loops.decision: Stepwise increase refresh interval. Down to spare_cadence minimum. Stop after max_degrade_level reached.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Projection builder, WebSocket push loop, frontend polling
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: CPU cycles from redundant projection rebuilds
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Polling storm when no data has changed; frontend rendering work for stale projections
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Stepwise degradation: 1x → 2x → 4x → max 30s interval. Must restore immediately on next projection.changed event. Must emit projection.refresh_cadence_reduced telemetry event.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit projection.refresh_cadence_reduced with new_interval_ms, unchanged_count. No projection content.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows 'Refresh cadence reduced' subtle indicator

proposed_control_loops.name: Worker file lease conflict → reroute or serialize subagent
proposed_control_loops.decision: If lease holder is active: serialize work (wait for release). If lease holder is stale: reclaim lease and reassign. If lease expired: reassign immediately.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Worker pool, coordination store, lease manager
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: Subagent CPU (prevents competing subagents on same file) + disk I/O
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Concurrent mutation on same file by different subagents; merge conflict storms
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Reassignment only if (a) lease expired, or (b) lease holder is confirmed stale (no heartbeat > 2x TTL). Must emit coord.lease.reclaimed telemetry event. Must record causation chain.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit coord.lease.reclaimed with lease_id, previous_holder_hash, path_hash. No raw file paths.
proposed_control_loops.reaction_timing: immediate for expired; delayed for contested (wait for heartbeat confirmation)
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows 'Lease conflict resolved' with agent assignment

proposed_control_loops.name: Telemetry opt-out → degrade adaptive diagnostics + mark degraded mode
proposed_control_loops.decision: Reduce adaptive diagnostic detail. Mark optimization mode as 'degraded'. Preserve basic function. Do NOT degrade security, governance, or redaction.
proposed_control_loops.affected_subsystem: Telemetry pipeline, DuckDB analytics, Ralph scanner, diagnostics
proposed_control_loops.resource_conserved: Disk I/O (reduced telemetry detail) + privacy compliance
proposed_control_loops.failure_mode_avoided: Emission of telemetry data against user consent; privacy violation
proposed_control_loops.safety_gate: Degradation must preserve: security checks, governance gates, redaction, bridge health. Only degrade: analytics, diagnostic detail, optimization hints. Must emit telemetry.opt_out_detected with degraded_level and downgraded_components.
proposed_control_loops.telemetry_implication: Emit telemetry.opt_out_detected with degraded_level, downgraded_components. No PII. No session data.
proposed_control_loops.ux_visibility: Frontend shows 'Telemetry: degraded mode (opt-out active)' indicator

event_command_boundary_findings.boundary_rule: Event says: backend appears stale. Command would be: restart_backend_loop. Event must not auto-restart. Event may trigger governed: bridge.status_refresh.requested (read-only, no mutation).
Event says: rate limit low. Command would be: pause_all_github_calls. Event may trigger governed: github.polling_cadence.reduced (degradation, not mutation).
Event says: forbidden pattern found. Command would be: delete_artifact. Event must trigger governed: redaction.quarantine_triggered (defensive, no deletion). Event must block release_gate promotion.
Event says: evidence sufficient for final validation. Command would be: run_full_pytest. Event notifies UI and release gate. Developer must initiate final validation explicitly.

Event says: two agents want same path. Command would be: force_reassign. Event triggers governed: coord.lease.conflict_resolution_requested. Resolution must check lease state and heartbeat before reassignment.
Event says: tool pressure rising. Command would be: kill_tools. Event triggers governed: runtime.serialization_mode.activated (throttle, not terminate).
Event says: projection data updated. Command would be: force_refresh_frontend. Event triggers governed: projection.push_to_subscribers (broadcast, not mutation).
Event says: lease time elapsed. Command would be: reclaim_and_reassign. Event triggers governed: coord.lease.reclamation_evaluation before any reassignment.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: Frontend currently polls projection at fixed interval. When backend is stale or disconnected, frontend continues showing last-known state without degradation indicator. User sees 'connected' when bridge is actually degraded.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Propagate bridge lifecycle events → frontend derives live bridge health state (connected, alive, idle, stale, degraded, failed). Show degradation reason. Never show fake-green.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: BridgeRuntimeStateTracker exists (8 states per-connection) but its events don't feed other subsystems. GitHub rate-limiting, test pressure, and worker scheduling are unaware of bridge state.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Publish bridge.bridge_runtime.transition events to event fabric. Let resource allocator subscribe to bridge degradation to adjust other subsystem cadences.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: Backend projection loop, frontend polling loop, and bridge heartbeat loop operate independently. When bridge disconnects and reconnects, backend may start duplicate projection loop per connection.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Propagate bridge.session.{started,closed} events. Backend must check for existing loop before spawning. Bridge must emit connection identity events for deduplication.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: Reconnect logic is hardcoded in bridge state machine. No adaptive backoff based on failure frequency or backend health signals.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Emit bridge.reconnect.failed events with attempt count. Reconnect policy subscribes and adapts backoff window. Emit bridge.reconnect.exhausted when max attempts reached.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: Projection freshness is not surfaced to other subsystems. GitHub operating picture doesn't know if projection is stale before consuming it. Ralph scanner doesn't know if evidence is current.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Emit projection.fresh and projection.stale events with sequence numbers. Consumers check projection freshness before consuming stale data.

frontend_bridge_backend_findings.finding: No live mission topology view exists. Bridge is first strand — the bridge lifecycle events are the first visible vibration in the web. Once bridge events feed a live topology projection, all other subsystems can be shown on the same fabric.
frontend_bridge_backend_findings.recommendation: Build MissionTopologyProjection as first event-fabric consumer. Show bridge strand first. Add workers, tools, GitHub, tests, release gate as additional strands. Show derived tension, not raw event streams.

github_integration_findings.finding: GitHub rate limit status is hardcoded as 'unavailable'. No live polling adaptation. No event when rate limit changes.
github_integration_findings.recommendation: Emit github.rate_limit.{healthy, near_exhausted, exhausted, restored} events. Security intake and public surface audit subscribe to adapt polling cadence.

github_integration_findings.finding: Dependabot and secret_scanning refusals are recorded in intake artifacts but not propagated as events. Other subsystems don't know permissions are insufficient.
github_integration_findings.recommendation: Emit github.permission.denied events with required_permission_sha256. Operating picture and release gate subscribe to show permission posture.

github_integration_findings.finding: No webhook event handling exists. Future webhook delivery failures (retry budget exhaustion, dead-letter) would be invisible.
github_integration_findings.recommendation: When webhooks are implemented, emit github.webhook.{received, delivery_failed, dead_lettered} events with retry_count and delivery_age. No raw webhook payload.

github_integration_findings.finding: Public surface program (audit → claims → packets → preview → publish PR) is artifact-driven but not event-driven. Each step reads static artifacts rather than subscribing to completion events.
github_integration_findings.recommendation: Emit github.public_surface.{audit_completed, claims_indexed, packets_generated, preview_ready, pr_proposed} events. Each step subscribes to previous step's completion event rather than polling.

test_release_gate_findings.finding: Tests run on developer demand or full-suite. No mechanism detects that running the full suite again would produce no new information (no files changed, targeted tests passed).
test_release_gate_findings.recommendation: Emit test.targeted_passed and test.files.changed events. Coordinator subscribes to detect 'test churn' — repeated full-suite runs with no change. Suppress with 'final validation justified' event instead.

test_release_gate_findings.finding: Release gate checks run on demand. No event signals that all pre-conditions are satisfied for promotion. Developer must manually know when to run release gate.
test_release_gate_findings.recommendation: Emit release_gate.evidence_converged when all blocking checks have passed evidence. Notify UI that promotion is eligible. Developer still explicitly initiates promotion.

test_release_gate_findings.finding: No mechanism detects tests that always pass regardless of code changes (fake-green).
test_release_gate_findings.recommendation: Emit test.classification.suspected_fake_green when a test passes across N consecutive code changes without any variance. Flag for human review. Do not auto-delete.

telemetry_redaction_findings.finding: Telemetry events currently carry bounded properties, but a pub/sub fabric risks payload creep — consumers requesting more detail than necessary.
telemetry_redaction_findings.recommendation: Every event must declare sensitivity_class. Events classified as 'telemetry_opt_in' or 'redaction_required' must never carry raw prompts, secrets, private repo contents, credentials, or private file contents. Detail level degrades with consent opt-out.

telemetry_redaction_findings.finding: Append-only JSONL event log could become a durable record of sensitive content if payloads are not bounded.
telemetry_redaction_findings.recommendation: Event log must be content-light by default. Payloads must pass through safe_summary() before emission. Raw code snippets, patches, diffs, and file contents must never appear in event payloads. Use SHA256 hashes for content-derived fields.

telemetry_redaction_findings.finding: Tests that validate event fabric behavior must test real events, not synthetic loops. Fake-green event tests would undermine trust.
telemetry_redaction_findings.recommendation: Event fabric tests must use real artifacts and real subsystem transitions. Tests cannot be 'did the bus emit?' — they must be 'did the bus emit at the right time with the right content-light payload after the right real condition?'

telemetry_redaction_findings.finding: Some events (tool usage patterns, model observation, code quality signals) could feed commercial derived datasets. Others (private code, credentials, session content) must never be commercialized.
telemetry_redaction_findings.recommendation: All events must carry sensitivity_class. Only 'public' and 'internal_operational' events may be aggregated for commercial use. 'telemetry_opt_in' requires explicit consent. 'redaction_required' and 'never_emit' must never leave local machine.

anti_patterns: Everything listens to everything: without subscription policy, every consumer subscribes to every event, creating N*M message storms.
Event storms: high-frequency events (heartbeat, chunk) flood the bus and drown signal events (degradation, quota exhausted).
Duplicate consumers: same consumer subscribes multiple times, processing same event redundantly.
Hidden command side effects: an 'event' triggers a chain of commands that mutate state without governance gate. Every mutation must pass through an explicit command gate.
Event-order dependency: consumers assume events arrive in specific order across producers, creating fragile temporal coupling.
Unbounded retries: failed event delivery retries without backoff or dead-letter queue, creating retry storms.
Frontend fake-green state: frontend shows derived state from stale events or fills in missing state with 'probably fine' defaults.
Telemetry payload creep: events start content-light but grow to include raw tool output, file snippets, or model responses over time.
Event logs becoming content leaks: append-only JSONL log accumulates sensitive payloads that can't be redacted retroactively.
DuckDB accidentally becoming mutation authority: read-side analytics query influences write-side behavior without command gate.
Tests that only validate synthetic event theater: tests confirm event emission but never validate that the event reflects real subsystem state transitions.
Bridge.STALE becomes bridge.DISCONNECTED without intermediate state: false-positive disconnections from transient backend blips.

transport.primary: append-only JSONL event log as first durable substrate
transport.live: in-process async pub/sub for live local consumers (asyncio.Queue per topic)
transport.frontend: WebSocket fanout only for frontend-safe bridge/projection status events
transport.analytics: DuckDB as read-side analytical projection only — never mutation authority

recommended_v1_architecture.subscription_policy: Consumers declare subscriptions by event_type prefix. No wildcard 'everything' subscriptions. Each subscription is registered, bounded (max event rate per consumer), and audited. Unauthorized subscriptions are refused.

envelope.correlation_id: links events in same causal chain
envelope.causation_id: parent event ID that caused this event

redaction_rules: Every event data field must pass through safe_summary() before emission
SHA256 all content-derived fields (file contents, code snippets, prompts, responses)
Never emit raw credential material, private keys, auth headers, or bearer tokens
Never emit raw repo file contents or code snippets as event data
Event data fields must not contain credential-like patterns or raw content fields as defined in the global redaction denylist.
Event data must not contain: credential field prefixes, auth header values, raw API responses, raw file bodies, diffs, code snippets, or secret material.
Artifact quarantine triggered by redaction.match_detected event
consumers: MissionTopologyProjection (frontend live topology view — bridge + workers + tools + GitHub + tests + release gate)
BridgeHealthProjection (bridge runtime state, connection health, degradation reasons)
WorkerResourceProjection (active workers, queue depth, lease conflicts)
GitHubIntegrationProjection (rate limit health, permission posture, webhook queue)
DuckDB read-side analytics (incremental refresh on batch events)

recommended_next_slice: Implement Event Fabric v1 / Local Propagation Bus v1 immediately after bridge liveness landing. The bridge is the first concrete producer/consumer pair: bridge emits lifecycle/status events, frontend consumes projection state, observability consumes lifecycle events, tests prove no duplicate loops. The event fabric then generalizes that pattern across all subsystems. Start with: bridge.* events → MissionTopologyProjection → spiderweb UX. Add resource.* and test.* control loops second. Add github.* events third.
intentionally_deferred: CloudEvents SDK adoption (use spec concepts, not dependency)
OpenTelemetry SDK integration (use propagation concepts, not dependency)
Event sourcing with replay capability (v1 is notification + projection; v2 can add replay)
Dead-letter queues for event delivery failures
Event schema registry as separate service
GitHub webhook event ingestion (wait for webhook implementation)
out_of_scope_risks: Event fabric adds indirection that makes control flow harder to statically analyze; must preserve explicit governance gates on all mutations
JSONL event log growth may exceed disk budget if event cadence is not bounded; must enforce per-event-type rate limits and total log size caps
In-process pub/sub may cause deadlocks if consumers synchronously call back into the producer's event loop; must enforce async-only consumers
DuckDB incremental refresh may become stale if event batches are lost; must validate projection freshness against event log sequence numbers
Spiderweb UX may mislead if derived tension shows 'degraded' when a subsystem is actually failed; must distinguish 'contact lost' from 'no events recently'
Event taxonomy proliferation: new subsystems adding event types without schema governance could cause the taxonomy to fragment; must require schema-governed registration for all new event types

spiderweb_ux_metaphor.metaphor: The event fabric is the spiderweb. The UX is the dew on the web. Every subsystem vibrates the web. The frontend does not poll and guess — it watches the web. Raw events are the spiderweb fibers. The UI shows where the web is vibrating (derived tension).
ux_projections: MissionTopologyProjection — live topology view showing all strands and their states
BridgeHealthProjection — bridge connection, backend liveness, projection freshness
WorkerResourceProjection — active/idle/blocked workers, queue depth, lease conflicts
GitHubIntegrationProjection — rate limit health, permission posture, webhook queue
TestPressureProjection — test churn detection, final-validation eligibility
spiderweb_ux_metaphor.derived_tension_rule: Never show raw events in the UI. Show derived tension. Instead of 'bridge.heartbeat_sent' repeated, show 'Backend alive · idle · projection unchanged · refresh cadence reduced'. Instead of 'github.rate_limit.near_exhausted' raw, show 'GitHub rate limit degraded · estimated reset 14 min'. The UI exposes where the web is vibrating, not every individual fiber.
